_meta._note: Every entry is the *source* of a RegExp built with the 'u' flag (design/narrative/style-guide.md section 8.1). Plain Thai/English words are valid regex sources as-is. Entries with regex syntax (e.g. negative lookahead) guard against matching inside a normal, allowed word (style-guide 6: 'ห่า(?![งน])' must not match "ห่าง"). W2d (slurs) and the full W7 (real brands) list are intentionally minimal placeholders here: narrative-designer owns and extends this content without a code change (style-guide section 9, copy-schema section 9 handoff #4).
